coverage: Interleaved independent session sequences including BigInt values
Independent refresh completion on separate connections
Authentication failure does not close another connection
Shared per-connection event count overflow does not consume another connection budget
Shared per-connection UTF-8 byte overflow does not consume another connection budget

coverageAdded: Independent session cursors and tool cards with reused tool-call identifiers
A gap in one session reconnects the shared socket and temporarily interrupts other sessions

limitations: The 1024-event and 4-MiB budgets aggregate all sessions on one WebSocket; an overloaded session can close that whole connection.
One real sequence gap reconnects the shared WebSocket; durable state must be loaded again after reconnect.
Separate connections have separate validation and queues but share the Node event loop; this is not performance isolation.
Ordinary RPC requests on one WebSocket remain serialized.
The production browser transport ran in a Node/Vite fixture, not an Electron UI.
